summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text names the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid (customError).

size.note: Track 32x20px with a 16px thumb (default), or 24x16px with a 12px thumb (sm).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: On state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor disables it without touching the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track: pill that holds the native input and the thumb; its fill shows the on/off state.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, transparent over the whole track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Circle that slides to the end of the track when on; pointer-events none.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). The form value is already updated when it fires.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary; thumb moves to the end (inline-end, so it mirrors in RTL).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt
invalid.note: Track border in destructive; the error text shows.

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. formValue(): value while on, null while off. formReset(): checked back to the checked attribute. formStateRestore(): checked from the restored state. validationAnchor(): the inner input (required -> valueMissing while off; error -> customError). Disabled (own or fieldset) is not submitted. syncFormState() runs in the change handler so a change listener sees the new FormData.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px); the label is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty (NativeControl).

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009); does not toggle, like the native control

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox input; aria-checked comes from its checked state (true/false, never mixed)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
the label does not change with the state (APG): on/off is conveyed by role and aria-checked
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: A compact settings list or dense panel
The setting is submitted with other fields
useCases.use: name (and value) inside a form; it submits only while on

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch whose label changes with its state ("On"/"Off", "Enabled"/"Disabled")
antiPatterns.why: The APG switch pattern keeps the label constant; the state is conveyed by role and aria-checked, so a changing label is read twice or contradicts it
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing several options from a list, or agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: Those are choices recorded on submit; a checkbox list reads that way, a switch reads as an on/off setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A button that toggles a formatting state in a toolbar
antiPatterns.why: That is a pressed button (aria-pressed), not a setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn uses bg-input (neutral-200), below 3:1 against the background (WCAG 1.4.11)
shadcn default track is 1.15rem (18.4px); rounded to the 4px grid the semantic tokens define

drift.contract: thumb is color.background in both modes
drift.realization: shadcn paints the dark unchecked thumb with foreground; one token per state keeps the contrast pairs checkable
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (shadcn: checked/defaultChecked)

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference for look, sizes (default, sm) and API; APG switch pattern for role and keyboard; Checkbox's form field layout.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch aria-checked>?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: native checkbox input with role=switch. It gives Space toggling, required/valueMissing, the browser validation message and label activation for free, and reuses NativeControl like Checkbox. A button would need all of that rebuilt.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. Enter submits the form as on every other form control (SB-0009), and Space toggles; this matches the native control and Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no, as Checkbox. The attribute is the default form reset restores (native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: yes, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name when other visible text names the switch.

openQuestions.question: What does an off switch submit?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: nothing, like a native checkbox (formValue() returns null while off). A server reads a missing name as off.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and how are they named?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: the visual reference's two, default and sm (api.json aliases them to medium and small), sized by the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens. No lg until one is asked for.

openQuestions.question: Does the thumb animate under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. The thumb moves instantly; the state still reads from the fill and position (WCAG 2.3.3).
